svg.title: The shrinking core, its exact energy factors and the growth path
svg.desc: A schematic meridional section of the region X between zero and X c and eta between minus eta c and eta c. The core shrinks radially like tau to the one half and axially like tau to D. Its leading tangential kinetic energy is C tan times tau to one half minus three h, while its leading radial energy is C r times tau to D. The full-field lower bound is evaluated at the Cartesian point square root of two X in tau, zero, zero. Every coefficient is specified in the lesson.

g.text: One shrinking region, two different measurements
Original variables: τ = 1 − t, A = 1/2 + h, D = 1/2 − h, 0 < h < 1/100.
Energy of the leading field inside this core
C_tan > 0 and C_r ≥ 0 are the complete integrals
in N1.29–N1.30, including π, L and every (1 − η²) factor.
The full corrected field has the separate global bound N1.41.
A growing component of the actual localized field
Every annular oscillation vanishes on this inner path.
The potential and time cutoffs equal one there.
Actual remainder and positive e₀: N1.42–N1.43.
Schematic section x₂ = 0. Positions show order; no numerical profile or parameter values are substituted.
